theorems.name: Submission.frt_cnm_densityRatio_lower_closure
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (E : Set (Euclidean N)) (c : ℝ≥0∞) (δ : ℝ), (∀ x ∈ E, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ ≤ δ → c ≤ densityRatio n μ x ρ) → ∀ y ∈ closure E, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ ≤ δ → c ≤ densityRatio n μ y ρ
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
